name: Cline Development Environment
description: Installs the Cline AI coding agent extension (saoudrizwan.claude-dev) for VS Code and Cursor, and optionally the cline CLI. Persists ~/.cline (provider keys, settings, history) across rebuilds and Codespaces via a Docker named volume, dedicated to this devcontainer. Also self-heals your devcontainer setup.

username.description: Username in the container that should receive the Cline data symlink. 'auto' detects vscode/node/codespace/uid-1000, in that order.

installCli.description: Install the Cline CLI (cline command) via npm. Requires Node.js/npm to be present in the container. Skipped with a warning if npm is not found.
